observations: The frontend routes the fixed exception-mask control to the selected provider bridge.
Both provider bridges submit NV04_CONTROL with the backend root client and allocated debugger object handle.
Pinned R580.196.07 and R595.99.02 RM source maps the public control to an internal debugger control and forwards it through the physical RM API with NV01_NULL_OBJECT.
The physical RM callback's fallback enters serverControl, which resolves hObject through the client's resource map before class dispatch.

The pinned RM resource-server code gives clients a nonzero handle base, registers the client proxy at its nonzero client handle, and generates nonzero resource handles when an allocation requests zero; the resource map lookup of zero therefore has no observed source path that can succeed.
